content.what_it_is: PARAM is the fixed-parameter and shared scratch-scalar module (L64-L88). It selects the model real kind and matching MPI datatype, defines mathematical/geophysical/numerical constants and densities, and declares global integer loop/index temporaries and real work scalars.
entities: integer parameters SP L67 and MPI_SP L68
shared integers I,J,K,RES L83; integer temporaries L84; real temporaries L85
unresolved: DEG2RAD=0.0175 at L80 is inconsistent with the module's own pi at L71: pi/180 is approximately 0.0174532925, so every direction conversion using DEG2RAD has about 0.267% scale error.

RHO_AW is documented as air density relative to water and set to 0.0012041 at L77, while the adjacent absolute values RHO_AIR/RHO_WATER at L78-L79 imply 0.00115. The two density representations differ by about 4.7%, so routines choosing one or the other do not share the same air-water ratio.
